evidence.observed_failure: Two original no-kick children refused with anchored_body_pose_unreachable_endpoint, after 725 and 283 completed walking commands. The original invalid results remain invalid.

question: Can a bounded body-height correction keep the actual four commanded leg endpoints within reach and actuator angle limits while preserving V50 foot paths, measured support gates, and motor law?

selected_law.nominal_body_height_and_startup_blend: Unchanged V50 nominal 0.33 m vertical leg reference and 72-command smooth startup.
selected_law.reserve_startup: Multiply reserve by the unchanged V50 startup scale, so the initial straight-leg geometry is not assigned an impossible full reserve.
selected_law.selection: Search the fixed grid from zero correction downward. Select the highest candidate within the correction rate bound for which all four planar endpoints satisfy the native positive-knee IK, every hip/knee target bound, and the required reach reserve. No feasible grid candidate means a verified safe refusal, not projection or bound relaxation.
selected_law.correction_rate_scope: Bounds the new height correction, not the unchanged parent nominal startup trajectory. Existing joint-reference slew and motor caps remain authoritative.
selected_law.initialization: Preserve the first neutral command and initialize correction to zero.
selected_law.zero_amplitude: Keep the previous body and foot references and correction; recheck actual IK through the parent path. Do not consume or restart walking startup time.
selected_law.memory: Add an optional, explicitly selected finite height correction to anchored pose memory. Historical policies omit it and reject cross-policy injection.
selected_law.receipt: Record nominal and selected height, prior and selected correction, actual correction interval, required reserve, selected four-leg reserves, and evaluated grid count. Geometry has no measured-contact authority.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: Read-only arithmetic on retained targets found that lowering to 0.320 m introduces hip-bound violations and 0.315 m also introduces knee-bound violations. Feasibility must check all constraints together. The retained-input calculation is not counterfactual physics evidence.

alternatives.choice: Project foot targets or relax unreachable-endpoint refusal
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would alter foot anchoring or accept an impossible request and obscure the observed failure.

required_validation: Native unit tests for reach, hip and knee constraints jointly; impossible populations; finite domain; and correction-rate limits.
Actual new DLL selection and stateless/session consistency with fresh V51 memory.
Exact original V50 responses reproduced with the new DLL, including both zero-actuation refusals.
Explicitly labeled counterfactual native calls on copies of the retained failed requests with new V51 memory; do not rewrite or regrade the originals.
Complete affected-path safety gate before a fresh development world through the production route.
not_covered: Partial-fall recovery entry and standing-dwell timeout are separate successor work.
Retained-input acceptance does not prove closed-loop walking or recovery success.
No new held-out population or physical execution authority is created by this component design.
